footer.tagline: Calm, considered movement for busy professionals

hero.subtitle: Northside Pilates is a quiet, considered studio for professionals who want strength and stillness without sacrificing their schedule. Fifty-minute sessions, expert instructors, zero chaos.

overview.title: Studio details, at a glance
overview.subtitle: Small classes, precise instruction, and a schedule built around the way professionals actually work.

classes.title: Choose the format that fits your body and your calendar
classes.subtitle: Every class is taught in small groups so instructors can correct form, adjust intensity, and keep each session genuinely useful, not just busy.

items.title: Reformer Flow
items.description: A full-body, spring-resisted class that builds strength and control at a steady, considered pace.

items.title: Mat Pilates
items.description: Classical mat work focused on core stability, posture, and breath, no equipment required.

items.title: Barre Fusion
items.description: Small isometric movements paired with Pilates principles for endurance and long, lean strength.

items.title: Private Session
items.description: One-on-one instruction tailored to injury recovery, specific goals, or simply your own pace.

items.title: Lunchtime Express
items.description: A condensed reformer circuit designed to fit neatly inside a workday break.

items.title: Restorative Stretch
items.description: Slow, guided mobility work to release tension built up from long hours at a desk.

schedule.title: Find a class that fits your week
schedule.subtitle: A full week of small-group sessions, timed around the workday.

instructors.title: Learn from instructors who teach with precision
instructors.subtitle: Every instructor at Northside is certified, experienced, and genuinely invested in how you move, not just how many classes you take.

items.name: Elena Marsh
items.bio: Trained in classical and contemporary Pilates, Elena designs every reformer sequence taught in the studio.

items.name: Owen Reyes
items.bio: A former dancer, Owen brings precise alignment cues to every barre fusion and mat class.

items.name: Priya Shah
items.bio: Priya works closely with clients recovering from injury or training around a demanding travel schedule.

items.name: Mateo Lin
items.bio: Mateo leads restorative stretch and recovery sessions built for people who sit most of the day.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, no long-term contracts
pricing.subtitle: Pick a plan that matches how often you can realistically make it in, and adjust any time.

plans.name: Drop-In
plans.description: Flexible access for an unpredictable calendar.
features: Online booking up to 2 weeks out

plans.name: Studio Membership
plans.description: Our most popular plan for a consistent, weekly practice.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.description: For clients who want Pilates woven into most weeks.

trial.title: Try your first class on us
trial.subtitle: Tell us a little about your schedule and preferred class, and our studio team will confirm a time that works.
benefits: A short fit assessment with an instructor
No payment details required to book
Flexible rescheduling if your week shifts
trial.successMessage: A member of our studio team will reach out within one business day to confirm your class time.
trial.successSubtitle: Check your email to confirm and access your first class.

contact.title: Find us in the heart of Northside
contact.subtitle: Walk-ins are welcome for a tour, but we recommend booking your free trial ahead of time so we can hold a spot in the class size.
